mapper.sql: p.policy_seq, p.policy_id, p.policy_name, p.role_seq, p.perm_seq, p.policy_type, p.enforce_level, p.condition_expr, p.target_field, p.message, p.alt_process, p.limit_amount, p.limit_qty, p.remark, p.use_yn, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_by, p.updated_at, r.role_id, r.role_name, pm.perm_id, pm.perm_name
FROM tb_policy p JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_seq = p.role_seq LEFT JOIN tb_permission pm ON pm.perm_seq = p.perm_seq

where.if: AND ( LOWER(p.policy_id) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(p.policy_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(p.message) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.condition_expr, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.target_field, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.remark, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_policy WHERE policy_id = #{policyId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(policy_id FROM 2) AS INTEGER)), 0) + 1 FROM tb_policy WHERE policy_id ~ '^P[0-9]+$'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_policy SET policy_name = #{policyName}, role_seq = #{roleSeq}, perm_seq = #{permSeq}, policy_type = #{policyType}, enforce_level = #{enforceLevel}, condition_expr = #{conditionExpr}, target_field = #{targetField}, message = #{message}, alt_process = #{altProcess}, limit_amount = #{limitAmount}, limit_qty = #{limitQty}, remark = #{remark}, use_yn = #{useYn}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE policy_seq = #{policySeq}
